title: Micheal Rad
body:
Description

Michael Rad, the beach ball extraordinaire and owner of the Radical Shack on Ferwater Island is the go-to guy for all your Oaklands beach needs. Whether you're looking for a beach ball to toss around or just want to catch some rays, his shack is open 24/7 and always fully stocked with the latest and greatest in beach gear. Just don't try to take a nap on one of his beach balls, or he'll make you roll all the way to the next island.
